## Feature Description
Describe the feature proposal. Why is it needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Implementation Details
Describe your planned solution or implementation approach. 
*   Which services, endpoints, or React components will be modified?
*   Are there any design assets or screenshots?

## Rationale
Explain why this feature matches the platform's objectives.
*   Does it improve SEO or visual aesthetics?
*   Does it improve NLP summaries or performance speed?
